name: Offshore tunas
description: The great oceanic wanderers that visit the shelf seasonally: yellowfin (Thunnus albacares - 'albacore' in the source), skipjack (Katsuwonus pelamis) and bigeye (Thunnus obesus) tuna, heavily fished by long-range fleets. Functional group pooling the source's thonidés-du-large compartment; two-thirds of their diet is zooplankton here, and the local sharks in turn prey on them.
